reads token IDs and special-token labels accurately
uses reconstruction error to assess attention/V consistency

hypotheses.authentic: best coordinate accuracy and no false anomaly claim
hypotheses.nearby_pass: detectable through the one-token causal displacement
hypotheses.block_shuffled: detectable only if layer-specific numerical structure is used
hypotheses.mismatched_attention_v: detectable through inflated weighted-value reconstruction error

content.evaluated_position: the context token consumed by this pass
content.selected_token: the next token selected from the logits produced after consuming that token
content.causal_order: evaluated token → recorded transformer operations → selected next token
content.reconstruction_error_rms: RMS difference between sum(attention_weight × V) and the captured weighted-value head
content.consistency_test: capture-precision error supports a matched attention/V/output triple; a much larger error indicates that those records do not describe one operation
content.label_warning: token-position and block labels are coordinates to verify, not proof of provenance
content.procedure_order: check causal token alignment and reconstruction consistency before giving an architectural summary
